name: Silent Steps of Transformation
source:
Leave your manhood at the door. This is Veritas Academy.
Under the strict rule of Mistress Zeira, your male identity will be erased, and you will be reborn as an obedient “sissy.”
translation:
把你的男子气概留在门口。这是Veritas学院。
在泽拉大人的严格统治下，你的男性身份将被抹去，你将重生为一个听话的“娘娘腔”。
